## Browsers

### Brave Origin {#brave-origin}

The lighter Brave, from the CachyOS repository

- **Handleiding:** [Browser]({{< relref "/docs/applications/browser" >}})
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3476-L3477)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Install packages from the repositories
pacman -S --needed --noconfirm --noprogressbar brave-origin-bin
```

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Remove packages, one at a time (one that something else still needs is kept)
pacman -Rs --noconfirm --noprogressbar brave-origin-bin
```

## Notes and passwords

### Standard Notes {#standard-notes}

End-to-end encrypted notes, from Flathub

- **Handleiding:** [Communicatie & Productiviteit]({{< relref "/docs/applications/productivity" >}})

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As you, from Flathub ---

# Install from Flathub
flatpak install -y flathub org.standardnotes.standardnotes
```

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

### LocalSend {#localsend}

Send files between your phone and the laptop

- **Handleiding:** [Utilities]({{< relref "/docs/applications/utilities" >}})
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3501-L3503) · [`plan_localsend`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3024-L3027) · [`off_localsend`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3035-L3038)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Install packages from the repositories
pacman -S --needed --noconfirm --noprogressbar localsend

# Open the LocalSend port (53317) in ufw
ufw allow 53317/tcp comment 'LocalSend-App'
ufw allow 53317/udp comment 'LocalSend-App'
```

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Close the LocalSend port in ufw again
ufw --force delete allow 53317/tcp || true
ufw --force delete allow 53317/udp || true

# Remove packages, one at a time (one that something else still needs is kept)
pacman -Rs --noconfirm --noprogressbar localsend
```

### AppImage support for TMOG {#tmog}

fuse2 for AppImages. Download TMOG itself from tmog.org

- **Handleiding:** [Utilities]({{< relref "/docs/applications/utilities" >}})
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3507-L3510)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Install packages from the repositories
pacman -S --needed --noconfirm --noprogressbar fuse2
```

**Voor jou over na het aanvinken**

1. Download the AppImage from tmog.org, then chmod +x and run it

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Remove packages, one at a time (one that something else still needs is kept)
pacman -Rs --noconfirm --noprogressbar fuse2
```
